title: Control exercises
description: Exercises that move one part of the vocal tract so you can check that only the matching reading moves. Shown in file order.

id.description: Stable id starting with c-. Practice history refers to it, so never change or reuse one that has shipped.

cue.description: Short name on the exercise card.

sub.description: A few words under the name on the card.

kind.description: Which movement is checked. Each kind has its own scoring rule in src/dsp.js (ISO_RULES), so a new kind is a code change.

vowel.description: Vowel key from the formant table in src/dsp.js: i (ee as in heed), I (ih as in hid), e (ay as in hayed), E (eh as in head), ae (a as in had), a (ah as in hod), c (aw as in hawed), V (uh as in hud), o (oh as in hoed), U (oo as in hood), u (oo as in who'd), r (er as in heard).

why.description: One or two sentences on what the exercise shows.
